display_long_description:
Hold the wall. Survive the next wave.

RiftWall combines stationary VR shooting with tower defense. Fight from a guarded platform, aim your weapon with the right controller and use the left grip for two-handed support.

Build five different turret types and face monsters with distinct movement and attack traits. Intercept incoming enemy projectiles before they hit your wall, and take on recurring mini bosses and major bosses as the pressure rises.

Start each run with a rifle. Every two cleared waves, choose one of three upgrade cards to unlock weapons or strengthen your build. Manually upgrade weapons during the run, while your hero, wall and turrets earn lasting progression. Wall and turret growth reaches level 30, with visible upgrades and experience bars.

There is no final wave. Continue from your saved wave checkpoint or start again from wave one. Protect the wall: when its durability reaches zero, the run ends.

A changes weapons. B opens menus. Upgrade-card choices pause combat so you can plan your next move.

In-game text is in Simplified Chinese. The preparation panel offers multiple languages.
